subject: Your 3AM trade alert is waiting
preview_text: Most users skip this feature, but it's the calm voice you need when markets get wild.
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling at 3AM when a sudden drop wakes you up and your gut says 'sell everything'? That's exactly when most traders make their worst decisions. But there's a reason the pros don't panic—they have a system that talks them down.

Turns out, the feature that 80% of our users never touch is the one that saves the most money. It's not the fancy charts or the AI predictions. It's a quiet mentor that steps in when your emotions are screaming. No hype, no FOMO, just a calm voice with data.

Inside Crypto AI, there's a hidden tab called Predictify Coach. Open it the next time you feel that urge to overtrade. Type in what you're thinking—like 'I want to sell ETH right now'—and it'll show you the data behind your impulse. Most users skip it because they think they don't need it, but the ones who use it cut their emotional losses by 40%.

Here's what I want you to do: Open the app, tap the Coach icon (top right), and type in a recent trade you regretted. See what it says. P.S. — If you're not on the 7-day free trial yet, now's the time to unlock the full version. The Coach alone is worth the $19.99/month, but it's on me this week.
